subject: Clearvault service review and verified findings
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Clearvault post-incident summary (for review)

Team —

I put together a customer-facing summary of last week's disruption for Clearvault (attached draft). Key asks before I send:

- Hannah: confirm the root cause wording and the short technical timeline (I pulled logs but want your sign-off).
- Diego: can you verify the token-cache eviction evidence numbers and confirm which hosts were impacted?
- Marissa: I'll include your AM note on next steps and the proposed credits/compensation; confirm the language so sales/legal are comfortable.

High-level summary I plan to share (short):
- What happened: transient KV cache eviction in dedicated pool caused increased upstream latency and a small percentage of token misalignments for sessions pinned to affected hosts.
- Why: a coordinated autoscaler/cleanup job concurrently reclaimed GPU memory on a subset of nodes during a peak prefix-aggregation window.
- Impact: ~0.6% of customer requests across their dedicated pool experienced 2–6s token delays between 03/14 21:07 UTC and 03/15 01:12 UTC.

I've included a proposed timeline in the draft and two attachments: the customer-ready RCA PDF and an internal evidence manifest (redacted).

Please review by EOD 3/16 so we can send to Clearvault Monday AM PST.

Thanks,
Jordan
--
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
Attachment: draft_clearvault_rca_for_review.docx (internal)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Mar 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Clearvault post-incident summary (for review)

Jordan —

Thanks for the draft. I've reviewed and made three small technical edits; main points:

1) Root cause refinement: the eviction was triggered by a legacy cleanup task that uses an LRU heuristic which didn't account for long-running cached KV entries for customer-specified pins. When the cleanup ran during a high-concurrency prefix flush it evicted active KV pages.

2) Timeline correction: eviction spike begins at 2028-03-14T21:06:12Z (we see the first OOM signal), not 21:07. Final recovery to normal KV hit-rate at 2028-03-15T01:18:05Z (we had to restart the controller on two hosts).

3) Evidence notes: Diego and I validated token-gap counts across three affected hosts (node-gp2-07, node-gp2-09, node-gp2-11). Aggregate impacted sessions: 4,972 (0.62% of requests in the pool). I've attached the redacted trace excerpt to the internal attachment set.

I'll inline the exact timeline table into the customer PDF (keeping it concise). Approve the change to say we \"repaired the eviction policy and deployed a hotfix\" rather than implying a full architectural change.

Hannah

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Mar 2028 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Clearvault service review and verified findings

Emily / Michael —

Thank you again for patience while we completed our internal review. Attached is the verified RCA summary for the 2028-03-14/15 service impact and the evidence manifest we can share at a Redacted level. I wanted to call out the most important customer-facing points up front: 

- What happened (short): an internal cleanup job triggered KV cache evictions on three hosts in your dedicated pool during a peak prefix-aggregation period, which led to increased per-token latency and session token misalignments for a small subset of active sessions.
- Scope & impact: 0.62% of requests from your dedicated pool experienced elevated latency (2–6s) and token delays between 2028-03-14T21:06:12Z and 2028-03-15T01:18:05Z. No data leakage or content alteration occurred.
- Remediation completed: we deployed a hotfix to the cleanup controller, adjusted autoscaler thresholds, and restarted two impacted hosts to restore KV hit rates to baseline.
- Immediate actions for you: we will provide the redacted evidence manifest and a session-level export for your engineering team by 2028-03-19 18:00 UTC.
- Preventative measures: we've changed the cleanup policy to exclude pinned customer entries, added health gating for autoscaler jobs, and are scheduling a formal dedicated-pool chaos test next quarter.

Attachments: clearvault_rca_v1.pdf (customer-facing RCA), evidence_manifest.xlsx (redacted trace counts; internal note: contains token-gap aggregate counts).

Next steps I propose:
1) Delivery of session export & evidence (ETA 2028-03-19 18:00 UTC).
2) 30-minute technical readout with Hannah and Diego to walk your engineers through the trace (please let me know availability; we can do 2028-03-20 or 2028-03-21).
3) Sales/rev discussion: Marissa will reach out separately on credits/compensation under your SLA.

We understand this was disruptive and appreciate your partnership as we tighten controls. Please reply with any immediate questions; Hannah and Diego are on-copy for accuracy.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
Attachments: clearvault_rca_v1.pdf, evidence_manifest.xlsx

Subject: Re: Clearvault service review and verified findings

Jordan / team —

Thanks for the detailed summary and for the clear timelines. A couple of quick follow-ups from our side:

1) Evidence & session export: we appreciate the ETA. Will that export include session IDs and timestamps for the impacted requests? Our security team will want to validate no PII was affected.
2) Credits: our procurement will want a clear calculation method. Can your team share the SLA clause you are referencing and the proposed calculation in writing?
3) Timeline clarity: can Hannah confirm whether any scheduled cleanup jobs overlap with our planned nightly batch window? If so, we need to coordinate to avoid recurrence.

We'd like to schedule the 30-minute readout on Tue 03/20 14:00 PST if that works for your engineers. Please confirm and send a calendar invite.

Emily Park
Senior SRE, Clearvault
emily.park@clearvault.com
